segments.he: שָׁמַעְתִּישֶׁפַּעַם אַחַת נִכְנַס אֶחָד אֶצְלוֹ, וְאָמַר לוֹ: בְּזוֹ הַשָּׁעָה  הָיָה  אֶצְלִי  הַשַּׂר  שֶׁל  יָוָן וְהַשַּׂר שֶׁל צָרְפַת וּבִקְשׁוּ אוֹתִי וְשָׁאֲלוּ מִי מֵהֶם יִכְבּשׁ, וְהֵשַׁבְתִּי  לָהֶם  מִי  שֶׁיַּחֲזִיק  יוֹתֵר  עִם יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא יִכְבּשׁ:
segments.en: (50.) Regarding the difficulties the world is accustomed to raise about tzaddikim — and particularly about him, about whom many difficulties were raised. He answered and said as a witticism: "Through the difficulties raised against us we have livelihood and wealth. For the wealth and livelihood of tzaddikim who engage in Torah for its own sake comes only through difficulties. For our Rabbis of blessed memory said [Shabbos 63a]: 'Length of days is in her right hand — in her left hand wealth and honor.' And they asked: 'In her right hand — length of days there is? But wealth and honor there is not?' And they answered: 'Kal vachomer'..."
